subject.title: fix(wechat): preserve existing accounts across hot reload

question: For the rebased exact head, should this shared Gateway lifecycle change require redacted live WeChat account-A/account-B QR-login proof, or may the focused lifecycle regressions and normal checks serve as the merge evidence?
rationale: The contributor has repeatedly documented that the required provider session is unavailable, while the patch affects generic Gateway lifecycle behavior beyond WeChat; accepting test-only proof is a maintainer risk decision.

options.title: Require live WeChat proof
options.body: Have a contributor or owner with a real QR-login setup attach redacted evidence that account A remains online after account B is added on the rebased head.

options.title: Waive provider proof for this head
options.body: Explicitly accept the focused Gateway lifecycle regressions as sufficient after reviewing the rebased exact merge result and checks.

recommendation.title: Require live WeChat proof
recommendation.body: Have a contributor or owner with a real QR-login setup attach redacted evidence that account A remains online after account B is added on the rebased head.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR was routed to this Gateway review candidate in the provided timeline, though ownership evidence remains limited.
